summary: Tested Pro Studio feature - backend APIs and frontend UI. Found and fixed critical bug: isAuthenticated was not exported from AuthContext, preventing authenticated users from accessing Pro Studio.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: isAuthenticated was undefined because it wasn't exported from AuthContext. Changed to use `const isAuthenticated = !!user;`

issues: Pro Studio button exists with NEW tag but onboarding modal frequently blocks view - testing confirmed button exists at data-testid='pro-studio-btn'

frontend_ui_tests.pro_studio_auth_view: PASS - Shows all tabs after fix
frontend_ui_tests.characters_tab: PASS - Create Character form and My Characters sections visible
frontend_ui_tests.cinema_studio_tab: PASS - Camera Body, Lens, Focal Length, Lighting options visible
frontend_ui_tests.shots_tab: PASS - Upload area and Generate 9 Shots button visible
frontend_ui_tests.video_tab: PASS - Video Model (Sora 2), Duration slider, Animate button visible

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fixed: ProStudio.js was using `isAuthenticated` which wasn't exported from AuthContext. Fixed by deriving it from user object.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pro_studio.py - New test file for Pro Studio APIs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro Studio feature is fully functional. Fixed critical auth bug. All backend APIs working. UI tabs (Characters, Cinema Studio, Shots, Video, Gallery) all render correctly. Onboarding modal may interfere with UI testing - set localStorage 'azories-onboarding-complete' to 'true' to skip it.

bug_fix_applied.fixed:
